minutes.headline: PACC's studio must move into one shared classroom as its building wing is closed by August.
minutes.summary: The Public Access Cable Committee held a light, largely procedural meeting dominated by a long-serving member's farewell remarks, scheduling of summer meeting times, and reappointment/liaison arrangements for two members and a Comcast-contract representative. The bulk of substantive discussion concerned the forced relocation of the cable studio into a single classroom as the building wing it occupies is closed and eventually demolished, plus routine manager's and treasurer's reports on FY27 budget planning, equipment, upcoming event coverage, and program output.

what_happened.line: The cable studio must relocate into a single shared classroom once the building wing housing it closes, expected after August 1.
The committee asked the town manager to inform the select board that a member will serve as its liaison on the Comcast contract.
Annual report and FY27 budget preparation will start in July instead of the usual February, at the town manager's request.
July and August meeting times were moved to the afternoon to accommodate members' schedules.
The Comcast payment for the quarter was noted as lower than the prior quarter, though it had not yet posted to the trial balance.

why_it_matters: A forced move of the public-access studio into shared classroom space could affect where and how local programming, including school and town meeting coverage, gets produced going forward.

Starting FY27 budget work in July rather than February gives the town manager, capital planning and the finance committee more lead time on this committee's request, which residents may see reflected in an earlier budget calendar.
No votes with financial consequence were taken; the reported figures on the Comcast payment are as heard on tape and unconfirmed against the trial balance.
